business_summary: ImageONE Co., Ltd. provides healthcare and global environmental business solutions in Japan. The company's Healthcare Solutions Business segment sells medical image storage, distribution, and display systems, ultrasound image reporting systems, cloud-based electronic medical record systems, nuclear medicine dose management systems, medical gloves, PCR detection reagents, antigen test kits, etc., as well as remote image diagnosis and other businesses. The Global Environmental Solutions Business segment sells automatic orthomosaic and 3D processing software for UAV-captured images, etc. It offers medical systems, such as medical software and EHR/EMR, as well as PACS medical image storage, distribution, and display systems; medical supplies, medical gloves, and PCR and antigen test kits; CTs, MRIs, x-rays, and mobile medical trucks; and clinical management support services. The company also provides solar panels and wind turbines; and GEO mapping, GIS solution, and UAV capability services, as well as distributes and reuses EV batteries. In addition, it offers tritium separation technology; tritium continuous measurement; radiation tolerant cameras; viDocRTKrover, a measurement tool that uses tablet terminals; and 3D image processing software for use in construction, civil engineering, and surveying sites. The company serves companies, hospitals, medical institutions, government agencies, and power companies. ImageONE Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.
